name: Paraphraser
description: Text rewriting utility. Rephrase sentences to simplify concepts or adjust phrasing.

howToUse:
1. Paste the text you wish to rewrite.
2. Choose an alternative writing style.
3. Click 'Paraphrase' to process the text.
4. Review the newly structured sentences.
features:
• Sentence Restructuring
• Meaning Preservation
• Style Variety
